programs.title: Chopped Junior
programs.desc: Four youngsters who starred in "Rachael vs. Guy: Kids Cook Off" return to compete and win over judges Tiffany Derry, Amanda Freitag and Tia Mowry  the junior chefs face a leftover burger, then try to work cake batter into chicken dishes.

programs.title: Chopped Junior
programs.desc: The first round basket contains rock shrimp and beef tongue  in the second basket, the chefs get quail and a variety of tiny foods  a groovy cake adds color to the dessert round.

programs.title: Chopped Junior
programs.desc: The junior chefs are tasked with creating meals that their moms would love  the first round basket holds escargot and fruit pops  a pricey cut of meat and a gummy candy in round two.

programs.title: Chopped Junior
programs.desc: The appetizer round features a weird hot dog and a cheese that doesn't want to melt  retro candies result in some surprising pops in the entree plates  cookie dough in the dessert basket.
